title: Plan born from 2026-05-30-001 dogfood findings D029 + D028
body: Two orchestrator correctness bugs found while deploying the onboarding plan with DontPanic itself: (D029) no_progress breaker trips on verdict-string equality not finding-set, capping volleys at 2 rounds; (D028) audit-envelope filename reuse makes finalizer/close pick a stale higher-index verdict as latest. Operator chose a separate tracked plan (not inline hotfix) because these are governance-engine correctness changes warranting cross-model audit.

title: Land via codex audit-only, not volley (self-deadlock avoidance)
body: This plan fixes the convergence loop, so it must not depend on that loop to land. Each feature is implemented by hand (or claude) then verified via single-agent `dontpanic <plan> --feature FNNN --role auditor` (codex) + the no-paid signed_off finalizer. Mirrors how F003 of 2026-05-30-001 was landed once the volley path proved structurally blocked by D029.
